summary: Solo hiker fell to his death off East Thorn near Mt. Silverthorne; 45+ volunteers spent three days locating and extracting the body — a 500-ft uphaul and 1,500-ft technical lower — ahead of a snowstorm
location: East Thorn, Gore Range near Mt. Silverthorne
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group + mutual-aid teams from neighboring counties, Flight for Life
notes: Multi-day body recovery; National Guard hoist declined; 3,000 ft of rope used
